notes: Your logo now shows in Gmail, Outlook and everywhere else. It was embedded in the email as data, which only Apple Mail renders - the copied email now points at a hosted copy instead, while the preview and the PDF keep the embedded one so they still work offline. Crew booking: the Include their day rate tick box is gone, replaced by a rate box against each person in the roll-call. Set it there and it goes in their booking email; leave it blank and there's no rate section at all. The rate box on their crew card and the one in the roll-call are the same figure, kept in step as you type.
